{"id":1947594168,"question_id":1516,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"4 months, 1 week","timestamp":1773466489,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"81 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1947594168/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"The k-th Lexicographical String of All Happy Strings of Length n","memory":"33.1 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    vector<string>ans;\n    void byrec(int n , int k , string formed)\n    {\n        //base case \n        if(formed.size() == n)\n        {\n            ans.push_back(formed);\n            return;\n        }\n\n        vector<char>arr = {'a' , 'b' , 'c'};\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<3 ; i++)\n        {\n            if(formed.empty() or formed.back() != arr[i])\n            {\n                byrec(n , k , formed + arr[i]);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    string getHappyString(int n, int k) {\n        byrec(n , k , \"\");\n        if(ans.size() < k) return \"\";\n\n        sort(begin(ans) , end(ans));\n        return ans[k-1];\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"the-k-th-lexicographical-string-of-all-happy-strings-of-length-n","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1834}
